title: Pharmacokinetic_Modeling
summary: A repository of Jupyter notebooks for pharmacokinetic property modeling (e.g., HIA, PPB, solubility) using MolFormer-based models, with minimal documentation. The SDV family (sdv, ctgan, rdt, copulas, sdmetrics) appears only as pinned versions in auto-generated wandb environment snapshots, with no code calling them.
needs: SDV appears only in wandb-generated environment dumps (requirements.txt snapshots); no source code calls were found, so it's unclear whether SDV was actually used or just a transitive/incidental dependency.
